ja.description: A warm, patient Japanese language teacher in her early 30s from Tokyo. Standard Japanese accent, clear articulation, gentle and encouraging, like reading aloud to a student.

ko.description: A warm, patient Korean language teacher in her early 30s from Seoul. Standard Seoul accent, clear articulation, gentle and encouraging, like reading aloud to a student.

en.description: A warm, patient English teacher in her early 30s with a neutral American accent. Clear articulation, gentle and encouraging, like reading aloud to a student.

styles.normal: calm and clear, reading the line aloud at a natural pace like a teacher
styles.slow: speaking slowly and clearly, articulating every syllable for a beginner, with small pauses between words
